nf2b1858b0b.headline: The Fed holds interest rates steady as the economy faces deep uncertainty
nf2b1858b0b.summary: The Federal Reserve kept its benchmark interest rate unchanged as it faces inflation pressure from the war with Iran and a weakening labour market.
nf2b1858b0b.why: The Federal Reserve sets US benchmark interest rates, which influence borrowing costs, the dollar and asset prices worldwide.

nbdd6be8a4d.headline: Australia Treasurer flags tax reforms in May budget as Iran war threatens economy
nbdd6be8a4d.summary: Treasurer Jim Chalmers will push for more tax reforms in the May budget as part of a productivity drive, aiming to prepare the economy for an inflation shock from the Iran war.
nbdd6be8a4d.why: The federal budget sets fiscal policy, tax settings and spending, which influence growth, inflation and government bond issuance.

n81c927e50f.headline: Diesel price hike inches towards R8 a litre - OUCH
n81c927e50f.summary: Latest indicators point to a sharp increase in South African fuel prices in April. Diesel is moving toward R8 a litre, a difficult month for motorists.
n81c927e50f.why: Diesel prices feed into transport and logistics costs, which affect inflation and the margins of businesses that rely on road freight.

n8b8220eb4f.headline: Inflation slows to 3% in February, but spike likely in April
n8b8220eb4f.summary: Consumer price inflation slowed to 3% in February, but a spike is likely in April. The easing is unlikely to persuade the central bank to cut rates.
n8b8220eb4f.why: Inflation data shapes the South African Reserve Bank's interest-rate decisions, which affect the rand, bond yields and borrowing costs.

n441bdf4c1d.headline: Waaree Energies, Indosolar shares gain up to 11% today; here’s why - BusinessToday
n441bdf4c1d.summary: Waaree Energies shares jumped 10.56% to Rs 3,186.15 on BSE, after touching an intraday high of Rs 3,222.75 against a previous close of Rs 2,881.95.
n441bdf4c1d.why: Waaree Energies is an Indian solar module manufacturer and one of the country's largest renewable-energy equipment producers.

n6dc0502a44.headline: Treasurer signals tax and savings budget shake-up amid war uncertainty
n6dc0502a44.summary: The treasurer will outline how the May federal budget responds to the crisis, with a focus on substantial savings, productivity and tax changes to make the system fairer for younger Australians.
n6dc0502a44.why: Federal budgets set government spending and tax policy, which influence fiscal sustainability, interest rates and household finances.

nf498a48d32.headline: Sensex Rises 633 Points To 76,704, Nifty Gains 196 Points to 23,777, Markets Extend 3-Day Winning Streak
nf498a48d32.summary: The Sensex rose 633 points to 76,704 and the Nifty gained 196 points to 23,777, led by IT stocks, easing oil prices and value buying. Continued FII selling remains a concern.
nf498a48d32.why: The BSE Sensex is India's benchmark equity index, tracking 30 large companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange.
nf498a48d32.why_moved: IT stocks led the gains, supported by global market strength and easing oil prices, alongside value buying. Continued foreign institutional selling weighed on sentiment.

ndcf319c981.headline: Pressure on GOVT to reverse 2026 fuel levy amid Middle East conflict
ndcf319c981.summary: Calls from all sides are growing for South Africa to reverse 2026 fuel levy increases, as record fuel price hikes loom in April amid the Middle East conflict.
ndcf319c981.why: Fuel levies are taxes that feed directly into petrol and diesel prices, affecting inflation, transport costs and consumer spending. Government fiscal policy shapes these decisions.

n930ac605c2.headline: Good Morning America interview sparks a 3-way market signal as Tim Cook rejects retirement talk and oil tops $100
n930ac605c2.summary: US stocks advanced for a second day while oil traded above $100 a barrel after further Middle East attacks. Apple shares rose after CEO Tim Cook publicly rejected retirement talk.
n930ac605c2.why: The S&P 500 tracks large US companies, and Apple is one of the largest index constituents, so its moves influence broad US equity performance.

impacts.name: Apple
impacts.why: Apple shares rose after CEO Tim Cook publicly rejected retirement talk.

n930ac605c2.why_moved: Equities advanced alongside rising oil, while Apple gained after Tim Cook's public comments on retirement.

n0bf5425b24.headline: Electric Car Registrations in U.S. Plunge 41% as Gas-Powered Vehicles Gain Traction
n0bf5425b24.summary: US electric car registrations fell 41% as gasoline-powered vehicles gained traction. Honda cut production of three EVs slated for the US market.
n0bf5425b24.why: Honda is a major global automaker, and shifts in EV demand affect its production plans and the wider auto supply chain.

impacts.name: Honda
impacts.why: Honda cut production of three EVs planned for the US market in response to weaker demand.

n9908600286.headline: JBM Auto, Olectra Greentech, Ather Energy, Ola Electric shares jump up to 19%; here's why - BusinessToday
n9908600286.summary: JBM Auto rose 18.89% to Rs 585.30 and Olectra Greentech gained 17.13%, while Ola Electric and Ather Energy rose 5.34% and 3.58%, respectively.
n9908600286.why: Indian electric vehicle and auto component makers are closely watched by investors as the country expands its EV market.
n9908600286.why_moved: The input reports gains at market close for the four shares but does not state the cause of the rally.

n57c50f6c50.headline: EU offers to pay Ukraine to fix oil pipeline at the center of Ukraine-Hungary feud
n57c50f6c50.summary: EU officials have offered Ukraine money and technical help to fix a key oil pipeline to Central Europe. The move is aimed at persuading Hungary to drop its veto on major aid to Ukraine.
n57c50f6c50.why: Pipeline flows to Central Europe carry crude for refiners in the region, and EU aid decisions depend on unanimous approval by member states.

n53a9960154.headline: FPIs sell Rs 6,434 crore worth of Indian stocks daily in March; what’s next? - BusinessToday
n53a9960154.summary: FPI equity flows into India turned negative again in March and may stay volatile in the near term, Antique Stock Broking said. Heightened geopolitical tensions in West Asia are cited.
n53a9960154.why: Foreign portfolio investors are a major source of liquidity for Indian equities, so their flows move the BSE Sensex and NSE Nifty. Outflows often pressure the rupee as well.
n53a9960154.why_moved: Foreign portfolio investors have been net sellers of Indian equities in March, with heightened West Asia tensions cited as the source of volatility.

na3508aba22.headline: LPG supply woes: Kerala hotels call strike on March 23, demand essential service status - BusinessToday
na3508aba22.summary: Hotels and eateries across Kerala will remain shut on March 23 in protest over commercial LPG supply problems. They are demanding essential service status.
na3508aba22.why: Commercial LPG is the main cooking fuel for restaurants and hotels, so supply shortages hit hospitality businesses directly. Energy supply disruptions can reduce output and revenue for consumer-facing firms.

n4b73db03e0.headline: Treasurer warns of major economic damage from Iran war
n4b73db03e0.summary: Fresh Treasury modelling shows oil price shocks and soaring prices for other commodities will have a lasting impact on the economy. The Treasurer issued the warning.
n4b73db03e0.why: Australia is a major commodity exporter and importer of fuel, so commodity price shocks feed into inflation, interest rates and growth. Treasury modelling informs fiscal and policy decisions.

n5f36c92e4b.headline: ADB to provide $10bn in financing to Pakistan under new 5-year strategy
n5f36c92e4b.summary: The Asian Development Bank will provide $10 billion in financing to Pakistan under a new five-year strategy. The plan focuses on sustainable and inclusive growth led by the private sector.
n5f36c92e4b.why: The Asian Development Bank is a multilateral lender whose financing programmes shape infrastructure and development funding in its member countries.

n73c597e495.headline: Gulf bank stocks surge after UAE resilience package
n73c597e495.summary: UAE bank stocks jumped on Wednesday morning after a resilience package was announced. The banks had seen double-digit losses since the war began last month.
n73c597e495.why: UAE banks are major lenders in the Gulf, and their share prices reflect expectations for credit quality and economic activity in the region.
n73c597e495.why_moved: A UAE resilience package lifted banks whose shares had fallen sharply since the war began.

n59f1517fe1.headline: Tokenisation, stablecoins, and startup capital are reshaping Dubai’s digital asset market
n59f1517fe1.summary: Stronger market access and clearer operating frameworks are prompting companies in Dubai's digital asset market to build for scale, with tokenisation and stablecoins central to growth.
n59f1517fe1.why: Tokenisation and stablecoins are regulated digital-asset activities that increasingly link traditional finance with blockchain infrastructure.

n9bbd81e851.headline: Indian Bank, NaBFID to raise Rs 8 crore via bonds by March
n9bbd81e851.summary: Indian Bank and NaBFID plan to raise a combined 80 billion rupees from the corporate bond market by March, bankers said. The amount is about $864 million.
n9bbd81e851.why: Bond issuance by state-linked lenders shows funding conditions in India's corporate debt market.

entities.name: National Bank for Financing Infrastructure and Development

nbefb2bfc76.headline: Bangladesh to Join WTO Investment Facilitation Agreement
nbefb2bfc76.summary: Bangladesh's cabinet approved a proposal to join the WTO's Investment Facilitation for Development Agreement under the plurilateral Joint Statement Initiative. The decision was taken at a cabinet meeting chaired by Prime Minister Tarique Rahman.
nbefb2bfc76.why: The WTO sets global trade rules, and investment facilitation agreements aim to simplify cross-border investment procedures for member economies.

n6951ef1fda.headline: Gulf Banks Face $307 Billion Deposit Flight Risk if War Worsens, S&P Says
n6951ef1fda.summary: S&P Global Ratings said Gulf banks could face domestic deposit outflows of $307 billion if the Middle East conflict deepens. The warning came in an S&P report.
n6951ef1fda.why: Gulf banks are large regional lenders, and deposit flight would pressure their liquidity and funding costs.

n0b16dc4d5f.headline: Riyadh rocked by blasts as Iran widens war across Gulf energy hubs
n0b16dc4d5f.summary: Explosions shook Riyadh on Wednesday after Iranian ballistic missiles targeted the Saudi capital, marking a dramatic escalation of the widening war across Gulf energy hubs.
n0b16dc4d5f.why: Saudi Arabia is the largest oil exporter in the Gulf, so attacks on its territory directly affect global crude supply risk.
n0b16dc4d5f.why_moved: Iranian missile strikes on Gulf energy hubs raise supply-disruption risk for oil.

ndcdb55a18b.headline: Fed holds rates steady, warns of higher inflation amid US–Iran war uncertainty
ndcdb55a18b.summary: The US Federal Reserve kept interest rates unchanged and warned of rising inflation from the oil shock linked to the US-Iran war. Markets fell as uncertainty clouded the rate cut outlook.
ndcdb55a18b.why: The Federal Reserve sets US interest rates, which influence borrowing costs, bond yields and equity valuations worldwide.
ndcdb55a18b.why_moved: The Fed's warning of higher inflation from the oil shock clouded the outlook for rate cuts, and markets fell.

nd769dde956.headline: European Nations, Japan Say Ready To Help Secure Passage Through Strait Of Hormuz
nd769dde956.summary: The US, European allies and Japan said they are ready for appropriate efforts to secure passage through the Strait of Hormuz. Three countries said any effort would occur only after a ceasefire.
nd769dde956.why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of global oil and gas shipments, so naval security arrangements there matter for energy markets. Coordinated allied action would shape shipping risk and insurance costs.

nc80cebe1fe.headline: As Iran war spreads, a UN shipping agency is searching for ways to keep commercial crews safe
nc80cebe1fe.summary: The International Maritime Organization held an emergency meeting in London to find ways to protect shipping and commercial crews as the Middle East war spreads.
nc80cebe1fe.why: The International Maritime Organization is the UN agency that sets global shipping safety and security standards. Its rules affect shipping costs, insurance and routing decisions.

n9952003107.headline: Sunway Healthcare jumps 27.6% on Bursa debut in Malaysia’s biggest IPO in nine years
n9952003107.summary: Sunway Healthcare shares jumped 27.6% on their Bursa Malaysia debut. The listing raised RM3.3 billion from the base offering and overallotment option, Malaysia's largest IPO in nine years.
n9952003107.why: An initial public offering is a company's first sale of shares to the public, and large listings signal investor appetite and capital-market activity.

n8e9956da8a.headline: Hormuz Reopening Looks Unlikely Without a Ceasefire in Iran War
n8e9956da8a.summary: US President Donald Trump is seeking to reopen the Strait of Hormuz to ease a growing global energy crisis, but that is unlikely without a ceasefire in Iran.
n8e9956da8a.why: The Strait of Hormuz is a key chokepoint through which a large share of the world's seaborne oil passes. Disruption there directly affects global crude supply.

ndd4db95c68.headline: Thai industrial sentiment rises in February
ndd4db95c68.summary: Thailand's industrial sentiment index rose in February due to lower interest rates and the US Supreme Court's ruling on tariffs, the Federation of Thai Industries said.
ndd4db95c68.why: The industrial sentiment index is a leading indicator of manufacturing activity in Thailand, an export-oriented economy. Tariff and rate changes affect factory orders.

nd5bbdacf46.headline: Samsung weighs multi-year deals to ease memory chip crunch fears
nd5bbdacf46.summary: Samsung is weighing multi-year deals to ease fears of a memory chip crunch, a market where Samsung, SK Hynix and Micron together dominate global supply.
nd5bbdacf46.why: Samsung is one of the world's largest memory chip makers, and DRAM and NAND supply shape pricing across electronics and data centre markets.

n83e182400f.headline: Delgado named BAP’s first female president
n83e182400f.summary: The Bankers Association of the Philippines elected Ana Aboitiz Delgado, president and CEO of Union Bank of the Philippines, as president for 2026 to 2027.
n83e182400f.why: The Bankers Association of the Philippines is the industry body representing the country's banks and shapes banking sector policy dialogue.

n1c2378af67.headline: Samsung Considers 5-Year AI Memory Contracts as Shares Jump 6.5%
n1c2378af67.summary: Samsung is considering multi-year chip deals to stabilise supply as AI demand rises and shortages may persist for up to five years, with shares jumping 6.5%.
n1c2378af67.why: Samsung Electronics is a leading producer of memory chips, whose pricing and supply shape the AI hardware market.
n1c2378af67.why_moved: Shares rose 6.5% on reports of proposed multi-year AI memory chip deals aimed at stabilising supply as AI demand rises.

n23d713984c.headline: Tehran warns Gulf energy sites to evacuate after Iranian gas facilities hit
n23d713984c.summary: Iranian gas facilities in the Gulf came under attack on Wednesday, state media reported. Tehran said it would target a range of energy installations across Saudi Arabia.
n23d713984c.why: Gulf states supply a large share of the world's oil and gas, so attacks on energy infrastructure can disrupt global supply and push up energy prices.
n23d713984c.why_moved: Attacks on Gulf gas facilities and threats against energy installations raise the risk of supply disruption, which typically lifts oil and gas prices.

n62a82dfcbd.headline: DayOne Seeks to Double Loan to $7 Billion for AI Expansion
n62a82dfcbd.summary: Singapore-based data center firm DayOne aims to double its loan to $7 billion. The financing supports expansion of its Malaysia operations as AI-driven demand for financing accelerates.
n62a82dfcbd.why: Data center operators finance large capital projects with debt, and their growth reflects demand for cloud and AI computing capacity.

nac2207a65b.headline: ‘Indian Costco’: Australian-first store Grosco opens doors
nac2207a65b.summary: Grosco, an Indian-style wholesale store, opened in Australia, leveraging a business model similar to Costco amid rising immigration.
nac2207a65b.why: New retail formats targeting immigrant communities reflect demographic shifts and consumer trends, influencing retail sector dynamics in Australia.

n4f910a81b4.headline: Sen. Paul confronts Sen. Mullin over violent rhetoric at his DHS confirmation hearing
n4f910a81b4.summary: Senator Markwayne Mullin's confirmation hearing to lead the Department of Homeland Security included criticism from Senator Rand Paul, who voted against his nomination.
n4f910a81b4.why: Leadership at DHS affects US national security policies and regulatory environment, which can influence economic and geopolitical stability.
